title: Find
say: Five sources are read: processes, listeners, Compose services, client configs and remote URLs. In demo mode they are fixtures, so nothing on this machine is read.

title: Merge
say: Findings become candidates. A stdio process that owns a listener folds into it, and secret-looking strings are removed before anything is probed.

title: Probe
say: Only loopback endpoints are asked, with server/discover, initialize and tools/list. No tool is ever called and no credential is sent.

title: Check
say: Each server's tool metadata is hashed and checked for hidden characters, instruction-like text and broad schemas. That decides the status.

title: Compare
say: Each scan is compared with the last. The same server with a different metadata hash is a possible rug-pull: the tools changed after they were first seen.
